pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with deeply serrated, oak-leaf-like edge gradients. Boundaries exhibit high-frequency pixel-level angularity and non-linear indentations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned interstitial pathways with variable pixel width. Junction nodes primarily form three-way intersections. High continuity is observed across the visible mid-section and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured dorsal mane with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible along the neck silhouette against the background.
